latestVersion.changelog:
theme-park 3.2.0

- Enhanced description: now highlights support for hotel reservation, flight and train booking, itinerary planning, visa info, travel insurance, and car rental — all via Fliggy/Alibaba Group.
- Mandatory CLI execution: all outputs must be sourced from flyai CLI, with explicit installation and execution verification steps.
- Strict output requirements: every booking option must include a [Book](detailUrl) link; answers from training data are never allowed.
- Updated trigger and activation guidance, parameter collection sequence, and output formatting for consistency and compliance.
- Clarified supported queries (theme parks and major branded destinations only; excludes general attractions).
